description:
The SAP ABAP Developer performs analysis, documentation, development, coding, testing, debugging, and installs programs to support general business applications, and prepares program specifications and diagrams and develops coding logic flowcharts. 
 
  
 
 More specifically, the incumbent prepares functional and technical specifications, tests and deploys solutions as new enhancements or system implementation, and designs, develops and implements SAP code technologies in a (AIX/UNIX/Solaris/Linux) environment(s) using relational database technology (Oracle preferred). 
  
 This role also provides expert knowledge and understanding of SAP ecosystem including ECC and any additional SAP products, guides and recommends solutions to mentor less experienced developers and business SMEs, and provides expert technical knowledge with different areas of SAP and provide technical leadership for guidance and recommendations. 
 
 
 Preferred: SAP ABAP with OTC and PTP 
  
 
 Note: Looking for 2 resources 


 6m contract, plus ext. 
 Apply today!
